The summary email has been sent to m*****@example.com. Thank you for contacting us, and take care.

outbox.body:
Hi Ma,

Thank you for contacting claims support. Here is a summary of today's conversation.

WHAT WE DISCUSSED
  - You asked about a denied healthcare claim from March 2026 and how to submit missing documents.
  - You asked whether to use the member portal or claim upload link, with fax or mail as alternatives if online upload is unavailable.
  - You asked which file formats are accepted and whether there is a file-size limit.
  - You were advised that no specific format or size limit was confirmed and that a claims representative can clarify those requirements.
  - You asked for an email summary of the submission instructions to be sent to the address on file.

CLAIM STATUS
  CL-3001 (healthcare, filed 2026-03-01): DENIED
  Healthcare claim denied because the diagnosis report is missing.
  Reason: the submitted materials did not include the treating provider diagnosis report.

NEXT STEPS
  - Submit the diagnosis report via the member portal or claim upload link.
  - After submission, review usually takes usually less than a week.
  - The appeal deadline on file (2026-04-15) has passed; contact us if you'd like a claims representative to look into it.
  - Reply to this email or call us if you have more questions.

Best regards,
Claims Support
